Hello! I would like to make a request of my two OCs.

Minori:
A painter. Timid, gentle and loves animals and nature. Very religious, and can see spirits/demons. They can be paranoid and erratic, and are viewed as strange/suspicious. 

Coco:
Delinquent with a nice side. Gets into street fights often but has a strong sense of justice and tries to protect the weak. Very kind, but hot-headed. He gets shy and cries easily. Drinks and smokes.

Story:
Their story is set in the early 2000s, on an rural island. In their town, there has been an increase in missing people. They are working together to track down the person behind the disappearances, only to find out it's a malevolent spirit. The spirit can be represented with butterflies, and has hallucinogenic effects on anyone that is near it.

I've included 2 collage boards that show the aesthetics of their world. Feel free to include horror/paranormal motifs! 

Please draw freely! Thank you for your consideration!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/13SKRzv84i_ltuaohFINxVD4zNMl9-ENO?usp=sharing

🎮 LING (160 cm)
https://geeckek.notion.site/Ling-1481d0143d0780ea8131d1c59f67f125?source=copy_link

Please feel free to draw whichever character inspires you the most! I will leave the composition up to you! Thank you for your consideration!

Greetings! Really like your painting style and would love to collaborate with you 🥺🥺🥺🥺🥺!

*Character details:

Race: Elarien. Elarien are creatures with the power of infinite reincarnation, upon death they will be reborn as themselves in another timeline. 1. Elarien have a far greater ability to sense emotions than humans but are cursed to not be able to love - once an Elarien's love is reciprocated by the other person, the lover loses themselves, and is eventually consumed by the Elarien's heart. 2. Once Elarien love is reciprocated, the lovers will lose themselves and eventually be consumed by the Elarien's heart, erasing them from the world.2. When an Elarien dies voluntarily, they are reborn without the memories of their previous life. When an Elarien dies an accidental/involuntary death, they will retain the memories of their previous life.
- Backstory: Fearful of falling in love yet uncontrollably drawn to its warmth, Isolde feared that her lover would be consumed by her own heart, and so she chose self-immolation in order to cut off the possibility of being loved. During her soul's journey, Isolde voluntarily discards her heart and cuts off her perception of "love" in order to avoid the same ending again.
- After her rebirth, Isolde was filled with emptiness and confusion, and she always felt out of place in the world. Despite her inability to truly connect with others, she stubbornly maintains the remnants of aristocratic decency in her soul, as if it were her only fulcrum in the midst of chaos and loneliness. She is accustomed to presenting herself in a graceful and restrained manner, with a demeanor that is as calm as ice, as if she were an aristocrat isolated from the world. Her face is often lightly melancholy and detached, so that people can't help but want to go into her heart.
-Appearance
-Appearance: pale and very melancholic looking. *Pinkish-black faded hair, with two handfuls of all black in her cloaked hair*.
A mole under each eye

*About the costume details:
Hairstyle and hair accessories please draw the left bust.
*Thanks for reading and have a nice day~!

こんにちは！先生の絵が大好きです。 私のocをお願いしたいです。 承認していただければ本当にありがたいです！ original、西洋au全部大丈夫です。 好きな方向に描いてください！ 絵の時期や時期はいつでもいいので、楽な方でお願いします。 先生の解釈が入ることをお勧めします。 自由にしてください！ 衣装も自由にお願いします！ 新しくデザインしていただけると助かりますが、clothesを見て描いてもいいです。 詳細や雰囲気など、すべてお任せいたします！ 男性はきれいな外見なので、気楽に女性キャラクターを描くように描いてくださればいいです。  背景の透明化バージョンを一緒に送っていただけると助かります！ 絵の解像度が300dpi以上なら嬉しいです。 ただし、面倒な過程ですので、気軽に省略してもいいです。 金額や資料などの修正が必要な場合はお気軽に再リクエストをお願いします！ 読んでくれてありがとうございます！

Nice to meet you. I really like the atmosphere of your illustrations... If you don't mind, may I request you to do my oc?
Here is my introduction.

The one who reigns at the top of the kingdom, she looks like a 16-17 year old girl. She always reveals a smile, but it is close to a mask, and in fact, she has a thoughtful and cold heart.

🔻 Notes:
She has a little bit of black on the tips of her hair.
Pupil center is pink.
Moles are 2 on the left and 1 on the right
🔻Motifs:
Flower buds that are white on the outside and black on the inside
🔻Other references:
-Chess
Manipulate others and also yourself. She is in a state of daily fireless warfare.
-Empty frame/bird cage
An empty mind, a body that cannot be free.
-An antique to be displayed.
Always being seen by countless eyes, an object to be admired and dissected.

This is only for reference, so please feel free to draw freely without being bound by the material. I would appreciate it if you could separate the layers so that the address can be turned on/off...
If this is not your favorite setting/request, you are free to decline the request!
Thank you very much for your cooperation.

Hey, love your art!

- Hair has slimy tentacle texture.
- Pale body with an eye on the chest.
- Rocks an oversized doctor coat.
- Feet are sharp, or you can go for human feet with thigh-high boots if you prefer.
- Has this eye diamond angel and demon figure that often hover around him but only he could see them. Creep

Setting: Post-apocalyptic city with cyberpunk vibes – crumbling skyscrapers, flickering neon lights, chaos mixed with tech. No specific style preference. 

If the illustration could be used as a wallpaper either for phone or PC, that would be great. This will be for personal use ^-^

Get creative with it and enjoy! Thank you so much.

烏龍てゃ様、はじめまして！イラストを楽しく拝見させて頂きました。素敵な絵柄に惹かれて、可能ならば自キャラを依頼したいと思っております。

【依頼内容】
キャラ参照は下記のURLをご覧ください。和風ファンタジー世界に住んでいる子です。

🎎 兔族の天皇。京都出身。身長は165cm、18歳。
➤ 根暗な性格で冷たく見えますが、本性は強情で感情過激な暴君。
➤ 怪異によく憑かれて過保護に育てられた、人間離れの様な存在。
➤ 注意点：後ろの木は帯の布から生えています。つるし雛の人形は全部能面被りで、首から下げてる。目にハイライトがない。

【テーマ】
・このキャラをご自由に描いてください！
・ホラー表現OK
・圧が感じられるほどの冷たさ、激しいほど美しい様な雰囲気でお願い致します。
・「能、がしゃどくろ、幽霊、ひな祭り」のモチーフをどちらでもご自由に使って大丈夫です。
・その他は何でも構いませんので、お気軽に描いてください！

依頼内容に何か難しい点か問題点があれば、お気になさらずこの依頼をキャンセルしてください。ご検討のほど、何卒よろしくお願いします。
